d: A podcaster in need of catchy Christmas content offers to help Daniyal win over his love in exchange for the ability to record the process. As the two work together, it becomes clear that Daniyal might be trying to win over the wrong woman.
After her latest gallery exhibition literally goes up in flames, struggling artist Liv James accepts a teaching job at a local elementary school to make ends meet.

A best-selling author clashes with a laid-back bookstore owner during her final stop on a lackluster holiday tour. However, sparks soon fly when a playful bet pits her structured holiday traditions against his spontaneous festive spirit.
Returning to her South Carolina hometown reunites a recently divorced mother (Connie Sellecca) with her first love (Randy Travis).
